title: Inspo
brief: A reference layer for AI coding agents — real production websites with desktop and mobile captures, "real websites worth studying." Useful as grounding material when agents need to see how good sites are actually built.
details: Inspo (inspomcp.dev) is a curated archive of 832 production websites "worth studying," aimed squarely at coding agents as much as humans. Browse the archive yourself or search 2,320 captured screens — each entry carries style tags (minimalist saas hero, brutalist fintech, dark mode saas hero) that read like design-vocabulary search terms. The agent angle is the differentiator: one line (`npx -y inspo-mcp install`) turns the whole archive into an MCP server, so your agent can pull real captures, reference components, and each site's DESIGN.md when building. The pitch: "your agent doesn't have taste — lend it some." Useful when you want agent-generated UI grounded in real production references instead of generic defaults.
